name: @floorspec/assistant-solar
description: Non-normative solar assistant (FLR-T-16.1): ranks a Floorspec plan's roof faces by a typical year's sun after shade, lays out FS_energy arrays on the most productive ones within their setbacks, sized to a target, with an inverter and a rapid-shutdown initiator on a circuit, as one Floorspec Ops batch. An estimate to compare layouts, never a guarantee or a code check. Isomorphic and deterministic.
